Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a retired active license for mental health professionals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the creation of a retired active license formental health professionals; and adding a new section to chapter 18.225RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.225 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The secretary may issue a retired active license to any mentalhealth counselor, marriage and family therapist, licensed advancedsocial worker, or licensed independent clinical social worker who: (a) Holds an active license under this chapter or has held anactive license under this chapter no more than ten years prior toapplying for an initial license under this section; and (b) Does not have any current restriction on the ability to obtaina license for violation of chapter 18.130 RCW. (2) A mental health counselor, marriage and family therapist,licensed advanced social worker, or licensed independent clinicalsocial worker who obtains or renews a retired active license is exempt p. 1 SB 6328from continuing education or competency requirements.
